_comment: Shared FE<->BE SQL-classification contract (tech-debt audit D6). The frontend heuristic (SQLEditorUtils isMutatingStatement/isSessionSwitchStatement) and the backend authority (utils::sql::classify_sql_with_dialect) must agree on read-only vs not for these statements. Two tests read this one file: tests/utils/sql-classification-contract.test.ts (FE) and a unit test in src-tauri/src/utils/sql.rs (BE). Transaction-control (BEGIN/COMMIT) and EXPLAIN are intentionally excluded: the coarse FE heuristic does not gate them (the backend does), so they are not part of this shared contract.

cases.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM orders WHERE total > 100
UPDATE users SET name = 'x' WHERE id = 1
ALTER TABLE t ADD COLUMN c INT
WITH changed AS (DELETE FROM users RETURNING id) SELECT * FROM changed
